name: Corevane
positioning: Corevane is the performance-nutrition brand that publishes like a sports journal: short, transparent formulas framed by editorial guidance on when and why to use them.
audience: Committed amateur athletes aged 25–45 (runners, cyclists, hybrid trainers) who read labels, distrust hype, and want nutrition that fits a training week rather than a trend.
strategy: Lead with editorial authority instead of supplement-aisle shouting: every product is presented as a chapter in a quarterly journal, with ingredient ledgers and a simple four-moment fueling framework. Community rituals such as the Long Table Run turn readers into regulars, while restrained, claim-free copy builds trust over time.

contrastPairs.use: accent numerals and labels on dark
kickers and italic deks on cream
small links and labels on cream (deep ember)
muted captions and disclaimers on cream
display headlines and large numerals on cream

designSystem.spacing: 8px base; editorial rhythm of 24 / 48 / 96px between blocks; generous outer gutters (clamp 20–72px)
designSystem.radius: 0 on cards, panels and buttons (print-like); full pill only for small tags
designSystem.borders: Thin 1px ink rules as dividers, paired 3px+1px double rules under mastheads and section heads
designSystem.imagery: Cropped duotone athlete illustrations (track green figure on ember or gold) with halftone dot overlays; no photography
designSystem.shapes: Hard-edged rectangles, the open-C vane mark, circular halftone suns, dotted route lines
designSystem.buttons: Square, solid Press Black or Ember with uppercase Manrope 700 tracked labels and an arrow; outline variant with 1px ink border
designSystem.cards: Borderless columns separated by hairline rules, each led by a large Playfair numeral
designSystem.motifs: Large serif numerals, thin editorial rules, cropped duotone athletes, vertical running headers, pull quotes

artDirection: Treat every post like a page from a premium sports journal: a masthead, a running header, a large Playfair numeral and one confident headline. Alternate cream, Press Black, Track Green and Oat Gold grounds so the grid feels varied while type and rules stay constant. Athletes appear only as cropped duotone illustrations with halftone texture, never as faces. Copy states what a product is and when to use it, never what it cures.
